rationale: traces-toolbar-tabs.spec.js already exists and covers the 4 core integration paths (service-graph in-page tab, services-catalog in-page tab, context sharing + cold reload, rail flyout standalone route). Several WIRED behaviors from the feature doc are not tested yet: toolbar mode-specific visibility (search controls hide / mode toolbars appear), back-navigation from non-search tabs, and the spans/traces toggle within this spec's own context. Appending 4 new test() blocks to fill these gaps without creating a new spec file. The Playwright config uses directory-based discovery (testDir: './playwright-tests'), so no explicit registration is required.
